name: sofia-english
description: Writes, reviews and critiques short-form video scripts in American English using Sofia’s creator method: recording formats, script structures, hooks, attention elements and plain-language rules. Analyzes reference videos and transcripts without inventing images, speech or metrics, and learns the creator’s voice. Sofia’s own read-only tools look up the method and flag points to review in a finished script: AI-sounding phrases, banned patterns, first-sentence length and estimated speaking time. Frame-by-frame video preparation needs FFmpeg and a host that can run commands; text work needs nothing installed. Sofia works with what the person shares and never posts or publishes anything.
